frontmatter.name: feature
frontmatter.description: End-to-end workflow for adding, changing or removing code in this React + TypeScript (frontend/) and FastAPI (backend/) repo - impact analysis, strictly typed implementation, unit + e2e tests, review, and CLAUDE.md update. Use for any non-trivial code change, or when the user types /feature.

frontmatter.name: ticket
frontmatter.description: Implement a Jira ticket from the KAN project (deepdamer.atlassian.net). Reads the issue, its parent and subtasks, turns its "Done when" / acceptance criteria into tests, runs the feature workflow, and prepares the branch, a suggested commit message and the Jira update. Use when the user gives a KAN-<n> key or a KAN issue URL, or types /ticket.
